FACE / THROW DIRECTIONLeft / right input · Right stick

Menus: arrows + Enter; Esc returns. Controller: stick / D-pad, A / × confirms, B / ○ returns. Click the game and press a controller button to connect. In character select, A / × on another controller joins P2; each player confirms a different warrior.

LIGHT & HEAVY

Light chains three strikes, stepping forward on the second and third. Kael’s heavy spins and launches. Lyra’s heavy fires a knockdown arrow. Garran charges forward behind his shield and launches enemies.

AERIAL ATTACKS

Jump and steer. Both fighters chain three aerial light strikes with a bilateral second strike. Kael’s airborne heavy launches; Lyra shoots diagonally down and forward. Garran slams down and launches enemies on both sides.

GRAB & THROW

At very close range, light grabs a human enemy for up to 2 seconds with invincibility. Choose left or right and press light again to throw them; landing deals damage.

RAGE SPECIALS

Hits build rage; taking damage drains it. At full rage, Kael leaps into a ground slam. Lyra fires a rising volley that rains arrows over a wide area. Garran’s Sunfall shield slam also launches nearby enemies. All rage attacks defeat common enemies.

READ YOUR ENEMIES

Sword bandits reach farther. Bruisers launch you with a mace. Dogs circle and pounce at your last position. Watch archers draw, then leave the arrow’s lane, dodge or jump.

FOOD & CONTAINERS

Barrels and crates block movement. Break them to release food. Stand directly over it and press light to restore 25 health. Some containers hide a life potion: one missing life for every player, or resurrection for an out-of-lives partner.

THE PIT

The pit is lethal. Avoid its edge—or throw enemies into it. Heavy strikes can launch them toward it.

GARRAN’S GUARD

His dodge steps backward while his shield guards the front. His shield charge also blocks frontal damage. His back and recovery remain vulnerable.

SELENE’S WITCHFIRE

Chain three light casts. Air casts fire diagonally down. Ground heavy launches foes in front; aerial heavy slams the ground and launches foes on both sides. Dodge teleports backward. Rage burns a broad area in front of her.

THREE LIVES

Respawn by dropping in from above with brief invincibility and nearby enemy knockdown. This test starts with full rage. The test arena is empty for practicing moves. The Bandit King awaits at the end of Forest.

BARBARIAN / WAR AXE

KAEL

Kael once guarded a burial gate beneath the Ashen Reach. Morvane’s bandits burned his clan’s hall and broke its seals, leaving him to bury his kin.

Carrying their war axe, he follows the raiders out of the mountains. He will find the queen who ordered the slaughter and bury her beside her dead kingdom.
